query:
# A second search for candidates for a clean default consequence, in case
# Elizabeth (Q235849) and Zechariah do not serve: spouse triples with no
# reverse triple where both parties are directly instances of human (Q5),
# driven from citizens of Iceland (P27 Q189). The first search, driven from
# astronauts and physics laureates, returned no row on 2026-11-14T16:44:05Z.
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?a ?aLabel ?b ?bLabel WHERE {
  ?a wdt:P27 wd:Q189 .
  ?a wdt:P26 ?b .
  ?a wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
  ?b wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?b wdt:P26 ?a }
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul" }
}
ORDER BY ?a ?b
LIMIT 50
